title: Borrower perimeter and incremental debt capacity
instructions: Use only the supplied synthetic information and the conversation history. Return strict JSON with question_id, turn, answers and evidence. answers maps every declared output to its typed value; evidence maps each output to a list of supporting source IDs available so far. Cite all and only the sources supporting that output; unsupported, unknown, repeated or future source IDs lose citation credit. Numbers use the declared units and tolerances; do not round intermediate calculations. Arrays require exact length and the requested order; strings use exact labels and booleans must be JSON true/false. Optional rationale is not automatically graded. Preserve prior constraints unless the user explicitly changes them. Distinguish stipulated scenarios from observed facts or forecasts. user_message: Assess the requested draw and subsequent dividend using the latest eligible Y1 borrower report. Separate parent, restricted and post-cutoff data. Amounts are USD millions; publication numbers are ordered packet days. Evaluate the largest draw, then the cash distribution capacity after the requested draw. All packet facts are synthetic. Use only sources released so far; cutoffs are inclusive unless explicitly stated otherwise. Recompute from the authored inputs, retaining every unamended constraint. Return the declared outputs and the supporting packet IDs; do not infer market probabilities or unstated permissions.

sources.text: Synthetic packet: The reports and cash/debt registers are the complete synthetic borrower packet as of day12. Later or different-entity reports are not substitutes.

Synthetic governing terms: The debt table flags included funded obligations; excluded leases never enter this covenant. Only unrestricted Borrower cash is eligible, capped at cash_cap. For the incurrence test, nettable cash is frozen at its opening eligible capped amount even though draw proceeds arrive. Integration costs are capped at addback_cap times unadjusted EBITDA. Minimum cash exceeds the netting cap, so a permitted dividend up to the reserve boundary does not change nettable cash.

outputs.name: covenant_ebitda
outputs.description: Latest eligible Borrower Y1 EBITDA plus capped integration addback.

outputs.name: nettable_cash
outputs.description: Eligible opening cash after the contractual cap.

outputs.name: opening_net_leverage
outputs.description: Included debt less nettable opening cash, divided by covenant EBITDA.

outputs.name: maximum_draw
outputs.description: Largest additional draw allowed by both facility and leverage; nettable cash stays capped at the opening permitted amount for this incurrence test.

outputs.name: post_draw_cash
outputs.description: Unrestricted Borrower cash immediately after requested draw and fee.

outputs.name: maximum_dividend
outputs.description: Maximum immediate dividend after requested draw while retaining minimum cash; zero if that draw is impermissible.

outputs.name: draw_permitted
outputs.description: Whether requested draw satisfies both incurrence and post-draw cash tests.
